title: Technology Sector Update for 10/26/2018: PFPT, MLNX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, GOOGL - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -2.17%
AAPL: -1.57%
IBM: -0.99%
CSCO: -1.85%
GOOG: -5.26%
Early Friday trading saw sinking technology stocks.
Among the stocks moving on news:
(-) Proofpoint ( PFPT ), which was slumping more than 15% as the pace of growth in its costs and expenses took the shine off a beat on both sales and earnings in the third quarter.
(+) Mellanox Technologies ( MLNX ) was up by more than 12% after a CNBC report said the networking products hardware manufacturer and supplier enlisted a bank as an adviser to explore a potential sale after it received expressions of interest from at least two companies.
In other sector news:
(-) Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) was down by more than 5% after it reported Q3 revenue of $33.74 billion, up from $27.77 billion in the year ago quarter but below the analyst consensus of $34 billion on Capital IQ. Earnings were $13.06 per share, up from $9.57 per share in the year-ago quarter and ahead of expectations of $10.41 per share.
